skipped.reason: no seed produced an initial set with both labels

design.description: Per modelled group with >= 12 training experiments, target experiments (a lowest-O2 quartile, a lowest-minimum-airflow quartile and one campaign) are held out of the pool. Each seed draws 3 random pool experiments (both labels present, <= 50 redraws) as the initial training set; then up to 10 rounds, each strategy picking one whole experiment from the remaining pool. EVR value of an experiment = joint block expected variance reduction of its observation points over the target points (uniform weights = held-out observation coordinates). Baselines: uncertainty_sampling (mean epistemic MI over the experiment's points), nearest_gap (experiment centroid closest to target centroid in standardized units among experiments with mean nn distance to training > 1; fallback closest), random (seeded). Evaluation: log loss and Brier on held-out target observations (never in training). Hyperparameters: MAP-II on the current training set only (3 restarts initially, then warm-started single-restart refits); pressure length scale fixed at 0.3.
limitations: Every observation is at ~1 atm, so pressure plays no role in this evaluation.
Targets are real experiments of the same groups and may be easy or hard for reasons unrelated to acquisition; classes are imbalanced (mostly sustained).
Scenarios in one group share experiments and are not independent; seeds are not independent samples of the world, only of initial sets.
Experiments are the acquisition unit; the real candidate set (single points) differs.

scenarios.name: lowest_o2_quartile
scenarios.target_definition: experiments whose mean O2 is in the group's lowest quartile (<= 17.26 %)

majority_class_baseline.note: constant prediction equal to the mean seed initial-training prevalence; for reference only

evr_minus_random.metric: area under target log-loss curve (negative favours EVR)

evr_minus_uncertainty_sampling.metric: area under target log-loss curve (negative favours EVR)

evr_minus_nearest_gap.metric: area under target log-loss curve (negative favours EVR)

scenarios.interpretation: Scenario lowest_o2_quartile, 20 seeds, 10 acquisition rounds: target log-loss area under the curve was higher (worse) than random selection (paired difference +0.092, 95% bootstrap CI +0.048 to +0.133); target log-loss area under the curve was lower (better) than uncertainty sampling (paired difference -0.039, 95% bootstrap CI -0.065 to -0.017). Majority-class constant baseline log loss on the target: 0.555; mean final EVR log loss: 0.567. Small samples; interpret as indicative only.

The advantage is small-sample evidence only. Scenarios share the same groups and are not independent.
